name: Jump for Lucky Blocks
desc:
Welcome to Jump for Lucky Blocks!

✨Jump up and grab Lucky Blocks that spawn!
🧊Bring them back to your base to open them!
💸Open to get brainrots to collect cash!
🔋Upgrade your jump power to jump even higher!
🏗️Upgrade your base for even more slots!

Remember to like & favorite the game for updates! 👍⭐

❗Game is heavily inspired by Jump for Brainrots
